evidence: Scope: check 25 only. Read the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 26 / numbered check 25 says every dimension must send the judge into the live app via the browser tool, not source, memory or first paint. Internal Quality Checks row 26 agrees; Deterministic Checks row 28 (check-rubric-prompt.py) recognizes injected app_context. The frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:108-110 requires localhost:3000 plus Playwright MCP; staged-task-contract.md, 'prompt.md and app_context.md', prohibits source-derived verdicts. In citations below T means .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task. All five complete prompt.md files, all five complete judge.toml files and the whole injected context were inspected. Every judge.toml:6 resolves prompt.md and :8-12 configures Playwright MCP. T/tests/test.sh:195-200 actually substitutes tests/app_context.md into every */*/prompt.md; all five contain {criteria}. A read-only tomllib/in-memory expansion check found exactly five prompts with localhost:3000, configured Playwright, resolved context/criteria and respectively 1 Render, 1 Constraints, 58 Functional, 7 Polish and 6 Visual descriptors. Render: T/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1-10 says 'Evaluate the live ... using Playwright MCP', prohibits implementation files/scripts/bundles, and distinguishes editor text from execution. Its judge.toml:23-27 requires entering a new distinctive marker, pressing actual Run, and observing both preview and console; 'The marker merely appearing in the editor or a hardcoded sample is insufficient.' Constraints: T/tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:1-11 has the same live-browser/source boundary; :15-33 requires an actual new UI save and independent clean browser context, with an explicit Playwright context lifecycle. Its judge.toml:23-29 requires actual write response, normal fresh-context library loading and reload, and rejects health/static seed/localStorage alone. Functional: T/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:1,5,7,9-15 requires Playwright, live reload and product-data observations, forbids implementation/database bytes, and requires actual values and measured actions. The complete S01-S36 protocols direct UI runs, actual keyboard/click/input, timed waits, fresh readbacks and the one restart; examples :119-122 require authored output, :158-160 require delayed interaction, :320 requires real console expansion rather than reading source, :363-369 requires post-restart fresh browser read/write. Its browser instrumentation recipe :29-95 is trusted routing bookkeeping and explicitly 'does not ... produce the product verdict'; actual authored Runs remain mandatory. Its 58 injected descriptors refer back to these protocols and do not introduce source inspection. Polish: T/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:1-9 permits rendered DOM/screenshots/interactions, with application responses only for the prerequisite; :15-21 requires a live workspace reload; :43-49 mandates a real keyboard route, actual view/content changes and visible focus, forbidding pointer/programmatic focus/API shortcuts during that route. Its judge.toml:23 requires the mobile surfaces be reached and used, :68 requires activating an ordinary action. Visual: T/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:1-9 explicitly limits visual evidence to rendered screens; :24-37 requires live reload, desktop and roughly 390x844 surfaces and both themes; :44-50 requires observed rendered evidence and forbids fabricated views. Its judge.toml:99-104 requires comparing the same surfaces across viewport sizes. The common T/tests/app_context.md:12 requires two real dirty editors for conflict recovery and says request replay cannot prove it; :16 requires actual manual Run despite missing Auto-run; :26 preserves independently observed facts, and :30 says unavailable observations must be identified, never invented. No injected context contradicts the source ban. Adversarial reading, not newly executed variants: a polished first-paint shell with hardcoded sample output and a no-op Run fails Render's new-marker action; a browser-only saved library fails clean-context retrieval; code that merely contains event listeners cannot prove delayed handlers or keyboard navigation. Conversely, a conforming app with server-rendered library data, no JSON list endpoint, native/composite menus, a drawer layout and standard editor escape keys is explicitly accepted by Constraints judge.toml:27, Functional prompt.md:5, Polish prompt.md:43-47 and Visual prompt.md:35-37. Thus no credible false-pass or false-fail witness was found for this row. Supporting raw evidence, not a full judge run: qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json identifies browser_driver='direct pinned Playwright', paid_provider=false and oracle_score_claimed=false.
